name: es-foral-income-tax-navarra-credits
description: Calculate the 2026 Navarra IRPF quota credits and the housing benefits credited after the differential quota. Covers the ordinary Navarra quota-credit catalogue, benefits credited after the differential quota, the preserved pre-2013 home-purchase credit with its rates, lifetime capacity and income ceilings, and the Emanzipa and DAVID rent aid with the complete income measure and the monthly method. Use for deducciones Navarra, deducción por vivienda Navarra, Emanzipa, DAVID, ingresos familiares ponderados and abono anticipado in Navarra. Load es-foral-income-tax first for Navarra residence, the scales and the annual settlement. Basque residents use es-foral-income-tax-basque-credits. Split unchanged from es-foral-income-tax on 6 November 2026.
